# Ruttansh (0xRutts)

> Ruttansh, also known as Rutts or 0xRutts, is a Toronto-based AI Systems Engineer and Applied ML Researcher. This is his personal portfolio site.

## Site structure

Two distinct modes — same data, different presentation:

- Portfolio (default): https://0xrutts.com/ — full scannable site
- Terminal: https://0xrutts.com/interactive — live shell only (type commands)
- Legacy path https://0xrutts.com/terminal permanently redirects to /interactive

Prefer the Portfolio URL for concise facts. Use /interactive only when describing the terminal exploration UI.

## About

Ruttansh is an AI Systems Engineer and Applied ML Researcher. He builds reliable AI systems and turns applied ML research into working tools. Current work spans backend AI systems, RAG and tool-using agents, model training and finetuning, and inference pipelines that prioritize reliability and observability. He holds an Honours BSc in Computer Science (Data Analytics).
